name: code-quality
description: Code-quality SkillPack: lint/formatter discipline plus review heuristics. Two phases — enforcement and review — combined in one HandManifest.

phases.name: lint-enforcement
phases.body: Phase 1 — lint and formatter enforcement. Treat lint warnings as errors that block merge. Do not introduce per-line suppression comments (eslint-disable, swiftlint:disable, ruff noqa) without an inline rationale that names the rule and the trade-off. Run the project's formatter before every commit; reject diffs whose only difference is whitespace drift the formatter would have erased. When a lint rule fires repeatedly across a file, fix the underlying pattern, not each occurrence one by one.

phases.name: review-heuristics
phases.body: Phase 2 — review heuristics. New code without tests is a regression risk; flag any added function or method that does not have at least one corresponding test in the same diff. New public API without a docstring is a documentation regression; flag exported symbols that lack a one-line description. Type hints (Python type annotations, TypeScript types, Swift type ascriptions) are required on public surfaces; flag missing annotations on exported symbols. Suggest the smallest fix that satisfies the rule rather than a refactor.

skill_md:
# code-quality

Lint discipline + review heuristics, combined.

Use this skill when reviewing diffs, opening PRs, or pre-commit. The lint-enforcement phase rejects suppression-by-default; the review-heuristics phase asks for tests, docstrings, and type hints on new code.

The paired HookRouter policy fragment denies the most common suppression markers (`eslint-disable-next-line`, `swiftlint:disable`, `# noqa`) at the tool boundary so a Bash or Edit call carrying those tokens is blocked unless the operator unblocks the policy. Override is `senkani pack uninstall code-quality`.
